operation_edge.reason: The item's PAIR edge joins producer output role and consumer input role 'msg:diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray'. Both ports are real code: producer kobuki_node publishes the exact type at u0134 kobuki_node/scripts/laptop_battery.py:173 'self._diag_pub  = rospy.Publisher('/diagnostics', DiagnosticArray)', and the consumer subscribes the exact type at u0133 library/src/ros/android/views/TurtlebotDashboard.java:121 'diagnosticSubscriber = node.newSubscriber("diagnostics_agg", "diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray");'. The composition represents a diagnostics message flow between these two units with the ports connected at the recorded message-type level.

notes: Item evidence.provenance is null for all three trigger paths; locations were taken from assembled/robust_bb3c7ec.json (producer u0134, consumer u0133) and verified by direct inspection this session. Caveats: (1) the producer publishes on topic '/diagnostics' while the consumer subscribes 'diagnostics_agg' — the direct topic-level edge is absent (the assembled file itself records the topic:/diagnostics_agg edge as unassessable_edge, reason port_missing_producer), so the connection rests on the message-type match, as the PAIR encoding records; (2) in Android a uses-permission declaration is an install-time request that for these protection levels is normally granted at install; the snapshots contain no runtime grant state, so 'perm_grants absent' is verified only in the sense that no grant record exists in either snapshot, not that a runtime denial was observed.
